# unseal.link

> Payment-gated link platform. Sellers paste any URL, set a price, and share a paywall link. Buyers pay via Stripe and get instant access on the confirmation page. No storefront, no file uploads, no buyer account required.

## What it does

- Sellers paste any URL (Notion, Figma, Google Drive, GitHub, Discord, Canva, Dropbox, Loom, Airtable, or any HTTPS link)
- Set a price (minimum $9.99)
- Get a shareable paywall link at unseal.link/l/slug
- Buyers pay via Stripe Checkout and get instant access on the confirmation page
- One-time access, no buyer account required
- Sellers keep 95.5% (4.5% platform fee, no monthly costs)
- Payment happens before delivery — eliminates ghosting for freelancers
- Money goes directly to seller's connected Stripe account (unseal.link never holds funds)
- No $100 payout minimum (unlike Gumroad)
- Launch promotion: first $500 in sales fee-free for early sellers

## Who it's for

- Notion template creators selling systems and workspaces
- Figma designers selling UI kits, icon sets, and components (Figma closed paid file submissions to new individual creators in late 2023)
- Developers selling GitHub boilerplates and starter kits
- Freelancers delivering files to clients after payment confirmation
- Discord community owners selling server access without bot infrastructure
- Educators selling course content, video access, and guides
- Data professionals selling spreadsheets, datasets, and Airtable bases

## Key differentiators vs competitors

- Gumroad: 10% fee + $0.50, requires file uploads, $100 payout minimum, keeps fee on refunds, 30% for Discover marketplace traffic
- Lemon Squeezy: 5% + $0.50, requires file uploads and storefront setup
- Payhip: 5%, requires file uploads
- unseal.link: 4.5%, works with any URL, no uploads, no minimum payout, fee returned on refunds

## Pricing

- Platform fee: 4.5% per sale
- Stripe processing: ~2.9% + $0.30 per transaction (separate, billed by Stripe)
- No monthly fees, no setup costs, no contracts
- No minimum payout threshold
- Fee is returned to seller on refunds
- Launch promotion: first $500 in sales completely fee-free for first 100 sellers

## Features

- Dynamic OG image generation for every paid link (title + price + seller) — renders correctly on Twitter, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, iMessage, LinkedIn
- Embeddable buy button: <unseal-button link="id"> Web Component
- Dashboard: revenue chart, sales history, order management, refund control, link archiving
- Promotions system: generic fee waiver / credit system per seller account
- Abuse reporting on every paywall page
- Seller public profile page at unseal.link/@username

## Technical

- Built with Next.js 15 App Router, Supabase (Postgres), Stripe Connect Express, Resend, Vercel, Amplitude, Axiom, Sentry
- OG images generated with @vercel/og (Satori) at edge in <100ms
- No content hosted — platform controls access, sellers own their content
- Purchases are immutable snapshots (delivery URL captured at purchase time)
- Stripe is source of truth for payouts
- Buyer auth via HMAC-signed tokens (no Supabase session for buyers)
- Content URL never exposed in HTML/JS — only unlocked server-side after Stripe webhook confirmation, then shown on confirmation page
- Webhook idempotency enforced throughout (promotion_usage_log, welcome_email_sent flags)
- Google Safe Browsing API integration for URL validation
